checkedClosedFunction.text: function checkedClosed(ts){const edges=new Map();for(const t of ts)for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const id=[key(t[i]),key(t[(i+1)%3])].sort().join('|');edges.set(id,(edges.get(id)||0)+1);}if(!ts.length||[...edges.values()].some(n=>n!==2))throw Error('Closed interior requires an original checked watertight mesh');}
